summary: Phase 3 testing complete. Backend: 40/40 pytest PASS (test_backend.py + test_phase2.py). Frontend: All 13 critical flows PASS — Landing page (features/how-it-works/disclaimer), Login with Google button, login→/dashboard redirect, Dashboard (ticker bar with NIFTY/SENSEX/BANKNIFTY, index cards, commodities, sector heatmap, AI Market Summary, AI Activity Feed, LIVE indicator), Theme toggle (light↔dark via data-theme attr), Mode toggle (beginner↔advanced), Sidebar navigation to AI Picks/Trades/Portfolio/AI Chat (/assistant)/SIP/Settings, Settings shows Zerodha + Data Sources panels, Register has Google button (data-testid='google-register-btn'). Phase 2 infinite 401 loop bug is FIXED — AuthContext uses hasChecked ref to call /me only once. All endpoints reachable.

minor.issue: Still accepts unauthenticated user_id via query string (carry-over from Phase 2). Should require JWT for handshake.
No DB audit record persisted (carry-over from Phase 2).
session_token cookie uses samesite='none'+secure=true while access/refresh use samesite='lax'+secure=false — inconsistent (carry-over).

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 'WebSocket is closed before the connection is established' warning on every route change. LIVE badge still works after settle but the rapid close/reopen creates console noise.

issues: No visible issues — ticker bar, cards, sector heatmap, AI summary, top gainers/losers all render cleanly in both light and dark themes.

action_items: (Optional) Fix WebSocket reconnect strategy to avoid repeated 'closed before established' warnings on route changes — likely useWebSocket hook reconnecting without proper cleanup in StrictMode/route unmount.
(Phase 2 carry-over, low priority) Authenticate WebSocket handshake with JWT and persist Zerodha orders in DB collection.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js routes are inconsistent — sidebar uses /assistant for AI Chat but the original problem mentions 'AI Chat page'. Path naming OK but ensure consistency in future links.
ProtectedRoute does not show any loading skeleton while AuthContext is checking — could flash login briefly. Acceptable but consider showing spinner.
useWebSocket likely tries to connect on every page render causing the 'closed before established' warnings — add ready-state guard and proper cleanup on unmount.
Theme/Mode persistence via localStorage works; consider also syncing to user profile on backend so it follows the user across devices.
server.py still ~1140 lines (Phase 2 comment) — should be split into routers.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds admin on startup. Phase 2 TEST_ trades from previous runs persist in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 UI redesign is in good shape. The infinite 401 loop from iteration 2 is FIXED. Backend 40/40 green. Frontend all critical flows pass. Sidebar AI Chat link points to /assistant (not /chat). Register page Google button has data-testid='google-register-btn'. If retesting, ensure to clear cookies (not just localStorage token) before testing public routes — httpOnly cookies persist and PublicRoute will redirect to /dashboard if user is still authenticated. Only minor remaining issue is WebSocket reconnect console noise — not user-visible.
rca_of_the_issue: No new bugs found in Phase 3. The Phase 2 infinite 401 loop was correctly fixed in /app/frontend/src/context/AuthContext.jsx using hasChecked useRef gate and an empty-deps useEffect, plus resetRefreshState in api.js. Verified by navigating to / and /login — clean render, single /api/auth/me call (returns 401, AuthContext sets user=false, loading=false, no further calls).
